name: Traditional Plus Banana Shampoo for Medium Coats

variants.name: 300 ml
variants.about_this_item: Shampoo with a rich banana fragrance, for medium haired dogs and cats. Its gentle and emollient action gives the hair elasticity, making it shiny and soft. This product is more than 90% biodegradable. Due to the absence of sodium lauryl sulfate, the shampoo produces less lather. Sizes: 300 ml, 1 l, 5 l.
variants.feeding_instructions: Dilute 1 part of shampoo to 3 parts of water. Wet the coat with lukewarm water and rub the necessary amount of shampoo slightly into the coat for a few minutes. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. For the best result use the Banana Balsam afterwards.
